grammatica.evidence: Repeated template 'Integer, default `6`.' / 'Enum, default `"mat"`.' — terse tech-ref English; public literacy supplies syntax and register.

dialectica.evidence: Product rules not public: 'deferred, never truncated'; 'fails closed at startup'; 'Covered trays are always excluded from "top"' — asserted, not derived for type/default lookup.

rhetorica.evidence: Curated inventory and order: [rack]→[watering]→[alerts]; humidity_threshold nested under skip_when_humid; each key its own heading with type+default lead — choice among reference layouts.

arithmetica.evidence: Atomic type/default pairs (rows int 6, mode enum mat, quiet_hours [21:00,06:00], email no default, etc.) — not in public substrate; core of one-setting lookup.

geometria.evidence: H1 → intro → H2 TOML sections → H3 per setting → one H4 nest; self-contained heading blocks enable jump-to without reading siblings.

musica.evidence: Uniform front-load cadence: type and default first clause, one gloss sentence after — stock man-page/scannable-ref rhythm.

astronomia.evidence: Arc is promise ('Every setting below shows its default') then three equal catalog sections; flat intensity, no narrative climb — catalog trajectory chosen for lookup.

notes: Telos is single-setting type+default lookup; geometria/rhetorica carry most of that affordance; arithmetica holds the non-public facts.
